description: Create a user namespace (os.unshare) or join a namespace (os.setns): neither raises an audit event, so the runner's seccomp filter answers EPERM (MSHL-212); no nested user namespace, no private network stack, less kernel attack surface. Python 3.11 has neither function.

open_path.note: os.unshare and os.setns exist from 3.12 only
